dedupe_keys.name: cropos croatian positioning system gnss reference network

description: CROPOS is the national network of GNSS reference stations of Croatia, run by the State Geodetic Administration. It currently operates 41 reference GNSS stations about 70 km apart covering the whole country, which collect satellite observations and compute correction parameters delivered to users in the field over mobile internet. The system exchanges observations with neighbouring countries in real time, distributes observations and corrections in real time and for post-processing, and runs 24 hours a day; five stations (Čakovec, Dubrovnik, Poreč, Požega and Zadar) have been part of the EUREF Permanent Network since 16 June 2013. Services are DPS, VPPS and GPPS, and the download page gives registration instructions, a users' manual, terms of use and the application form. Fees are set by regulation (NN 56/2023, NN 106/25): post-processing data costs 0.06 EUR per minute, registration 40 EUR once, and archive data the per-minute fee plus 30 EUR per hour of preparation. Access needs registration and payment under the terms of use; no open licence is stated. Caveats: the site is mainly in Croatian. Coverage is Croatia. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, earthquake and geodynamics monitoring, and space weather effects on GNSS; related records are GNSSnet.hu of Hungary and CZEPOS of the Czech Republic.
